method: Official product pages, support documentation, developer-maintained store descriptions, and dated individual reviews. Documented behavior was not independently tested in each app. Reviews illustrate possible friction, not its prevalence.
productDirection: A private space for everyday contributions, shared activities, and memories. Remote experiences are complete experiences; meeting in person is never assumed or required.

products.name: Paired
interactions: Both people answer before viewing the other response
products.access: Free daily conversation; premium shared by both partners.
products.designDecision: Offer independent answers, topic choice, and skipping without deadlines. Write original prompts.

products.name: Between
interactions: Private media, notes, and shared dates
products.access: Bulk media and note export is documented as a premium feature.
products.designDecision: Make note ownership clear, keep notes easy to find, and include a portable journal export.

products.name: Agape
products.designDecision: Provide playful and everyday choices as well as user-written questions. Do not infer relationship quality from answers.

reviewSignal.finding: One reviewer reported repetitive or unsuitable prompts; the founder acknowledged different preferences for serious and playful content. This does not establish current prevalence.

products.name: SumOne
interactions: Next question waits for both answers
products.access: Free use with advertising and premium limits/features.
products.designDecision: Shared creation can be enjoyable without missed-day penalties. Store named time zones and handle daylight-saving transitions explicitly.

products.name: Locket
interactions: Small photographs delivered to a widget
products.access: Free with in-app purchases; native widget behavior is not promised by this web prototype.
products.designDecision: An ordinary photograph can be a complete interaction. Make it easy to post and revisit.

products.name: noteit
products.designDecision: Support handmade contributions, undo, and dependable drafts. Do not place missed-day messages among memories.

reviewSignal.finding: Two historical individual reviews said streak notifications displaced enjoyment of drawings. These reports do not establish current behavior or prevalence.

products.name: Couply
products.access: Free content with subscription; the product also advertises coaching features.
products.designDecision: Connect activities to plans and saved memories rather than expanding into relationship diagnoses or automated advice.

products.name: Cupla
products.access: Free and paid access; platform capabilities differ.
products.designDecision: Show proposed times in both locations and allow counterproposals without requiring full calendar disclosure. Visits remain optional.

historicalReference.name: Official
historicalReference.status: Discontinued in the second quarter of 2025, according to Bumble's filing.
historicalReference.designDecision: Keep user-created memories exportable. The closure does not establish why individuals used or left the app.

constraints: No copied question decks, artwork, or app copy
No relationship scores or therapy claims
No participation streaks or missed-day penalties
No assumption that partners will meet in person
